releases.title: EcoGreen Announces Strategic Expansion with Mega Hydrometallurgical Facility in Andhra Pradesh
releases.summary: New state-of-the-art facility will add 45,000 MT in annual recycling and hydrometallurgical processing capacity to meet escalating domestic EV and ITAD recycling demand.

releases.title: EcoGreen Surpasses 60,000 Metric Tonnes in Certified Enterprise E-Waste Recycled
releases.summary: Milestone reflects partnerships with over 340 institutional and corporate enterprises across India, driving 98% extraction efficiency for critical minerals.

releases.title: EcoGreen Awarded Dual ISO 27001 and Global Recycled Standard (GRS) Recertification
releases.summary: Third-party audit confirms military-grade chain of custody and cryptographic data destruction integrity alongside transparent circular secondary supply chains.

releases.title: EcoGreen Partners with Leading Automotive OEM for Closed-Loop Lithium-Ion Battery Recovery
releases.summary: Strategic collaboration focuses on safe discharge and hydrometallurgical recovery of battery-grade lithium, cobalt, and nickel with zero atmospheric emissions.

releases.title: EcoGreen Pioneers High-Purity Precious Metal Recovery from Complex ITAD Streams
releases.summary: Proprietary hydrometallurgical process safely extracts gold, silver, palladium, and copper at greater than 99.5% purity, establishing new standards for domestic urban mining.
